Показывает, насколько в рационе представ: Shows the representation of vegetables, fruit, leafy greens and legumes in the entered diet. The score uses the corresponding HEI-2020 components.
В расчёте участвуют четыре показателя HE: Four HEI-2020 components contribute: two for vegetables, greens and beans, and two for fruit. Vegetable components account for 65% of this domain score and fruit for 35%. These percentages refer to points, not food weight.
Показывает, насколько хорошо в рационе п: Shows how well whole-grain foods are represented and how the intake of refined grains, such as foods made with white flour, is scored.
75% балла даёт компонент HEI за цельные: The whole-grains HEI component contributes 75% of the score; the component for limiting refined grains contributes 25%. Refined grains do not substitute for whole grains.
Сколько белка содержится во введённых пр: Compares protein from entered foods with a calculated reference. It does not establish whether a person has consumed enough protein over an entire day.
До расчётного ориентира балл растёт вмес: The score rises with protein intake up to the reference, remains 100 between 100% and 150% of that reference, and gradually decreases above 150%. This is a rule of this exploratory model, not a universally accepted medical upper limit.
Показывает вклад молочных продуктов, кот: Shows the contribution of dairy foods identified in the diet. The model considers both food-group classification and their calcium and protein content.
42% балла составляет молочный показатель: The HEI dairy component accounts for 42% of this domain score, calcium from dairy for 28%, protein from dairy for 20%, and additional model rules for 10%. Calcium from other foods is not fully included here. Even with no dairy foods, the model may award 10 points if no penalties apply. See the nutrient section for total calcium intake.
Показывает, как введённые продукты оцени: Shows how the entered foods score for sodium, added sugars, saturated fats and selected other aspects of their composition.
70% балла зависит от четырёх показателей: Four HEI-2020 components—refined grains, sodium, added sugars and saturated fats—account for 70% of the domain score. Additional model rules account for 30%. A high score means fewer issues according to these selected characteristics; it does not demonstrate that a diet is safe.
Как соотносятся овощи, фрукты, цельные з: Examines the proportions of vegetables, fruit, whole grains and protein foods and how much of the diet's total weight these groups account for.
Система распределяет продукты по четырём: The model assigns foods to four groups and compares their shares by weight with a notional distribution: 35% vegetables, 15% fruit, 25% whole grains and 25% protein foods. This contributes up to 72% of the domain score. The remaining 28% depends on how much of the diet's total weight belongs to these four groups. The Harvard Healthy Eating Plate illustrates approximate proportions rather than exact gram targets, so this calculation is our approximation, not an official Harvard metric.
